subject: general
question: A bus passes two persons moving in the direction of the moving bus at a speed of 3 km/h and 5 km/h, respectively. The bus passes the first person in 10s and the second person in 11s. The speed of the bus is :
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the **speed of the bus** be **S** km/h.

Since the bus and persons move in the **same direction**, use relative speed: (S − Sₚ).

Distance (Bus Length) is constant ⇒ (S − 3) × 10 = (S − 5) × 11

⇒ 10S − 30 = 11S − 55

⇒ S = 25 km/h.

**∴ The correct answer is 25 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bddcb88ea2bfff5af2e688b07fdea6f5c8d6f408a5a9b29dc471435149e026c8.png] 

**Given:** Speed of 1st person = 3 km/h, Time = 10 s. Speed of 2ⁿd person = 5 km/h, Time = 11 s.

**Formula:** Distance = Relative Speed × Time

⇒ Convert time to hours or equate distance directly in consistent units.

⇒ (S − 3) × (10/3600) = (S − 5) × (11/3600)

⇒ 10(S − 3) = 11(S − 5)

⇒ 10S − 30 = 11S − 55

⇒ 11S − 10S = 55 − 30

⇒ S = 25 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 25 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed Concept

When two objects move in the **same direction**, relative speed is the difference (u − v). In **opposite directions**, it is the sum (u + v).

Unit Conversion

To convert **km/h to m/s**, multiply by 5/18. To convert **m/s to km/h**, multiply by 18/5.

Train/Bus Passing a Person

When a vehicle passes a person, the **distance covered** is equal to the **length of the vehicle** itself.</p
